description: This PHP source file defines the ListViewDisplay class, which manages the display and behavior of list views in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for setting up list views, processing data, rendering UI components like mass update forms, export links, selection controls, and handling user interactions within the list views.

classes.name: ListViewDisplay
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring, processing, and rendering list view interfaces in SuiteCRM, including mass update forms, action menus, export features, and user interaction controls.

methods.name: shouldProcess
methods.description: Determines if the list view should be processed based on session and configuration state.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the list view with seed data, filters, limits, and display options.

methods.name: setupFilterFields
methods.description: Generates filter fields based on display columns and seed field definitions.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Performs additional processing on the list data, preparing it for display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Produces the HTML content for the list view, including mass update forms.

methods.name: buildSelectLink
methods.description: Creates the HTML for the list view selection controls.

methods.name: buildActionsLink
methods.description: Builds the HTML for the actions dropdown menu in the list view.

methods.name: buildExportLink
methods.description: Generates the HTML link for exporting list view data.

methods.name: buildMassUpdateLink
methods.description: Creates the HTML link for mass update actions.

methods.name: buildComposeEmailLink
methods.description: Constructs the email composition link based on seed fields and user email client.

methods.name: buildDeleteLink
methods.description: Generates the delete action link.

methods.name: buildBulkActionButton
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the bulk action button in the UI.

methods.name: buildSelectedObjectsSpan
methods.description: Produces HTML for the UI component that shows selected objects count.

methods.name: buildMergeDuplicatesLink
methods.description: Generates a link for merging duplicate records.

methods.name: buildMergeLink
methods.description: Creates the merge records link, considering user permissions and module settings.

methods.name: buildTargetList
methods.description: Builds a link/button for adding records to a target list for marketing.

methods.name: displayEnd
methods.description: Outputs the bottom section of the list view, including mass update forms.

methods.name: getMultiSelectData
methods.description: Returns HTML for multi-select checkboxes and related hidden inputs.

methods.name: getMassUpdate
methods.description: Instantiates and returns a MassUpdate object.

methods.name: fillDisplayColumnsWithVardefs
methods.description: Enhances display columns with detailed field definitions from the seed's vardefs.
